attributes.__structure__:
ATTRS:
  description: Prediction of quantities of wells.
  VERSION: 0.0.0
COORDS:
  date_time:
    name: date_time
    coords:
    - date_time
    unit:
      tick: m
      tz: UTC
      dayfirst: false
      yearfirst: true
    type: datetime64[m]
    na_value: null
    description: Time coordinate
    df_col: date_time
    source_unit:
      tick: m
      tz: CET
      dayfirst: false
      yearfirst: true
    range: null
    composed:
    - date_time
    chunk_size: 1024
    step_limits:
    - 1
    - 1
    - hour
    sorted: true
  well_id:
    name: well_id
    coords:
    - well_id
    unit: null
    type: str[16]
    na_value: "\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\
      \uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF"
    description: Full borehole id.
    df_col: well_id
    source_unit: null
    range: null
    composed:
    - well_id
    chunk_size: 64
    step_limits: any_new
    sorted: []
  calibration:
    name: calibration
    coords:
    - calibration
    unit:
      tick: m
      tz: UTC
      dayfirst: false
      yearfirst: true
    type: str[16]
    na_value: "\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\
      \uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF"
    description: Date of calibration indexing the simulation parameters.
    df_col: calibration
    source_unit:
      tick: m
      tz: UTC
      dayfirst: false
      yearfirst: true
    range: null
    composed:
    - calibration
    chunk_size: 1
    step_limits: any_new
    sorted: true
VARS:
  water_level:
    name: water_level
    coords:
    - date_time
    - well_id
    - calibration
    unit: meter
    type: float64
    na_value: .nan
    description: Water table level, meters above see
    df_col: water_level
    source_unit: meter
    range: null
  water_depth:
    name: water_depth
    coords:
    - date_time
    - well_id
    - calibration
    unit: meter
    type: float64
    na_value: .nan
    description: Water level depth relative to the borehole head.
    df_col: water_depth
    source_unit: meter
    range: null
  longitude:
    name: longitude
    coords:
    - well_id
    unit: degree
    type: float64
    na_value: .nan
    description: GPS. Signed Earth longitude. Indicated by the probe itself.
    df_col: longitude
    source_unit: degree
    range: null
  latitude:
    name: latitude
    coords:
    - well_id
    unit: degree
    type: float64
    na_value: .nan
    description: GPS. Signed Earth latitude. Indicated by the probe itself.
    df_col: latitude
    source_unit: degree
    range: null
  Z:
    name: Z
    coords:
    - well_id
    unit: meter
    type: float64
    na_value: .nan
    description: Z-coord of well head above sea level.
    df_col: Z
    source_unit: meter
    range: null
